start.text: The shift is over. The transfers that did not fit were mostly one place: 198.51.100.23.
start.name: Joshua

A.text: Good work. The lesson is the same every time: allow only the places data is meant to go, and watch what leaves.
A.name: Carla

B.text: Some of the new cards [b][color=green]Charge[/color][/b]. Point at the word to read it. It pays now for Energy at the start of your next turn.
B.name: Carla

C.text: So I can spend a little now to have more next turn. And I buy the upgrade my clues point at.
C.name: Joshua

D.text: Exactly. Use your Security Points, and read what your clues recommended.
D.name: Carla

E.text: Understood. Fewer open doors, and a longer look at what goes through them.
E.name: Joshua
